about_short_description.short_description: Alizz Islamic Bank offers banking, financial, and wealth management services

product.name: Personal Banking Accounts
product.description: Sharia-compliant current, savings, and investment deposit accounts for individuals, with services for managing everyday finances and deposits.

product.name: Personal Finance
product.description: Sharia-compliant financing for individuals to fund personal needs, using Islamic financing structures rather than conventional interest-based loans.

product.name: Home Finance
product.description: Islamic home financing for purchasing, constructing, or improving residential property through Sharia-compliant financing structures.

product.name: Auto Finance
product.description: Sharia-compliant vehicle financing for individuals purchasing new or used cars and other eligible vehicles.

product.name: Islamic Cards
product.description: Payment cards that allow customers to make purchases, withdraw cash, and access account services under Sharia-compliant terms.

product.name: Digital Banking
product.description: Electronic banking services for viewing accounts, making transfers and payments, and managing banking activities through online and mobile channels.
